setting.culture: A Muslim family in Dammam on the Gulf coast of Saudi Arabia; low sand-coloured flat-roofed houses, a palm-lined corniche beside calm blue sea, date palms heavy with brown date clusters, falcons on padded perches; sandy paved ground.

data.title: Zaid and the Zing Ring

premise.hero_want: Zaid wants to make a ring zip along a string.
premise.problem: The ring stays still when the string is level.
premise.mechanism: Zaid lifts one end while Dad lowers the other, making the ring slide down the sloping string.
premise.resolution: The ring zips along the string and Zaid grins.

key_objects.name: Ring
key_objects.description: One large, smooth red wooden ring, easy for Zaid to hold.

key_objects.name: String
key_objects.description: One long, thick yellow string threaded through the ring.

cast.appearance: Short black hair, teal long-sleeved top, loose beige trousers and brown sandals. His knees and shoulders are covered. His eyes are solid black filled ovals with no highlights.
Short black hair and a neat black beard, wearing a white long-sleeved thobe and brown sandals. His eyes are solid black filled ovals with no highlights.

pages.text: I get a ring and a long string.
pages.scene: On sandy paving beside Dammam’s calm blue sea, Zaid holds the red ring and coiled yellow string. Dad stands beside him. Low sand-coloured houses, a date palm with heavy brown clusters and one falcon on a padded perch form the fixed background. All visible eyes, including the falcon’s, are solid black filled ovals with no highlights.

pages.text: I hang the ring on the string.
pages.scene: In the same spot, Zaid threads one end of the yellow string through the red ring. Dad watches nearby. The sea, houses, date palm and falcon remain fixed in the background. All visible eyes are solid black filled ovals with no highlights.

Zaid holds both ends of the level string. The red ring hangs still in the middle. He looks at it and thinks while Dad stands close by. All visible eyes are solid black filled ovals with no highlights.

Zaid gives Dad one end of the string and points down, clearly leading the plan. Dad takes the end. The ring remains still on the level string. All visible eyes are solid black filled ovals with no highlights.

pages.text: Dad dips that end. I lift this end.
pages.scene: Dad lowers his end while Zaid lifts his end, making one clear slope. Both keep hold of the string together. The red ring begins to slide towards Dad. All visible eyes are solid black filled ovals with no highlights.

pages.text: Zing! The ring zips on the long string. I grin.
pages.scene: The red ring zips down the sloping yellow string towards Dad. Zaid grins as they keep holding the two ends. The calm sea, palm-lined corniche, date clusters and perched falcon remain in the background. All visible eyes are solid black filled ovals with no highlights.

data.cover_brief: Zaid lifts one end of a yellow string while Dad holds the lower end. A large red ring slides along it. data.cold_read: A clear, playful six-page story at the published-exemplar level. Zaid has one simple aim, notices the problem, gives Dad the plan and helps make the ring move. The action stays in one place with one adult, two key objects and one easy-to-copy mechanism. The story text meets the Level 3 phonics contract, uses five distinct focus-sound words, and the read_words split is exactly two “ng” words plus four others.

issues.detail: “I tell Dad, ‘Dip that end!’” sounds slightly like a caption reporting speech. Direct speech is warmer and simpler: “Dad, dip that end!”

Page 2 must clearly thread the string through the ring, and page 1 must establish the separate objects, their usable shapes and the fixed left-to-right positions. No extra evidence or objects are needed.
